other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: same name 'Kundzwi' (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: One huge, lacy leaf on a mottled stalk with a 'knee', rising from a buried tuber on the forest floor.
teaser.sw: Jani moja kubwa lenye mapambo kama lasi juu ya kikonyo chenye madoadoa na 'goti', likichipuka kutoka kiazi kilichozikwa ardhini msituni.
teaser.dg: Kodza mwenga kulu, rinaloganyika vipande vinji, dzulu ya mlita wenye madowa na 'goti', rinalomera kula chiazi chiricho tsini tsakani.

summary.en: Kundzwi is a forest-floor aroid that grows from an underground tuber and puts up a single large, much-divided leaf. Pakia also lists the name ulanga for it, a name the Digo give to Polynesian arrowroot too.
summary.sw: Kundzwi ni mmea wa familia ya mayugwa unaoota sakafuni mwa msitu kutoka kiazi cha chini ya ardhi, na kutoa jani moja kubwa lililogawanyika sana. Pakia pia anaorodhesha jina ulanga kwa mmea huu, jina ambalo Wadigo pia hulitoa kwa Polynesian arrowroot.
summary.dg: *Kundzwi* ni mmea wa jamii ya *arum* wa photsi tsakani, unaomera kula chiazi cha tsini, na unalavya kodza mwenga kulu rinaloganyika vipande vinji. Pakia piya anaandika dzina *ulanga* kpwa mmea uhu, dzina ambaro Adigo nkurihumira piya kpwa *Polynesian arrowroot*.

about.en: Kundzwi is a tuberous herb of the arum family. In the rainy season it puts up one large leaf on a tall stalk, often mottled. The blade is divided again and again into many leaflets, so it looks lacy and fern-like. The genus name *Gonatopus* means 'knee-foot', after a joint or swelling on the leaf stalk. The flowers are borne low down, on a spike inside a hooded bract, and are followed by fleshy berries. In the dry season the leaf dies back and the plant survives as its buried tuber.
about.sw: Kundzwi ni mmea mdogo wenye kiazi, wa familia ya mayugwa. Wakati wa mvua hutoa jani moja kubwa juu ya kikonyo kirefu, mara nyingi chenye madoadoa. Bapa la jani limegawanyika tena na tena kuwa vijani vingi, kwa hivyo huonekana kama lasi au kama jani la kangaga. Jina la jenasi *Gonatopus* maana yake 'mguu wenye goti', kutokana na kiungo au uvimbe kwenye kikonyo cha jani. Maua huota chini kabisa, kwenye suke lililo ndani ya brakti yenye umbo la kofia, na hufuatwa na matunda yenye nyama. Wakati wa kiangazi jani hunyauka na mmea huishi kama kiazi chake kilichozikwa.
about.dg: *Kundzwi* ni mmea wa chiazi wa jamii ya *arum*. Wakati wa mvula unalavya kodza mwenga kulu dzulu ya mlita mure, ambao mara nyinji una madowa. Kodza riro rinaganywa tsona na tsona kukala makodza madide manji, kpwa hivyo rinaonekana dza nyuzi-nyuzi, dza kodza ra *fern*. Dzina ra jenasi *Gonatopus* rina mana ya 'goti-gulu', kpwa sababu ya fundo au phatu phanaphovwimba kpwenye mlita wa kodza. Maruwa ganamera photsi, dzulu ya mlita uriofunikpwa ni kodza dza kofiya, na badaye kunazuka matunda madide genye nyama. Wakati wa kazikazi kodza rinafwa, na mmea unasala dza chiazi chiricho tsini.

where.en: It grows in the shade of coastal forest, thicket and woodland, on the forest floor.
where.sw: Hukua kivulini katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka vizito na misitu ya miti iliyotawanyika, sakafuni mwa msitu.
where.dg: Unamera chivuri-vurini, photsi tsakani: kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, vitsakani na kpwenye matsaka ga mihi.

names.en: Digo: *kundzwi*, shared with Duruma and Giriama according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. His Appendix III also lists *ulanga* for this plant. *Ulanga* is the Digo name for Polynesian arrowroot (*Tacca leontopetaloides*), another tuberous forest herb with a single, deeply divided leaf, which may explain the shared name. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kundzwi*, jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Kiambatisho III chake pia kinaorodhesha *ulanga* kwa mmea huu. *Ulanga* ni jina la Kidigo la *Tacca leontopetaloides* (Polynesian arrowroot), mmea mwingine wa msituni wenye kiazi na jani moja lililogawanyika sana, jambo ambalo huenda linaeleza kwa nini wanashiriki jina. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *kundzwi*. Pakia anagomba kukala Aduruma na Agiryama piya anauiha vivyo, na kaandika manage. Kpwenye *Appendix III* ya Pakia, mmea uhu piya unaihwa *ulanga*. *Ulanga* ni dzina ra Chidigo ra *Polynesian arrowroot* (*Tacca leontopetaloides*), mmea wanjina wa chiazi wa tsakani, wenye kodza mwenga rinaloganyika sana, na hiyo inaweza kukala ndiyo sababu ya dzina riro kuhumirwa kpwa mimea yosi miiri. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.
